goalZh: 会用 What happened? 问经过,用不规则过去式和 First… / After that… / Finally… 按顺序讲一件事
canDoZh: 能按顺序讲清楚一件出了状况的事:丢了什么、怎么找到的、后来怎样

newItems.noteZh: What happened? 发生什么事了?;what 在这里作主语,不用 did(不说 What did happen?)。过去式 happened。
讲故事时接在 First… 后面:First…, then…, after that…, finally…;after 第 3 单元学过。
放在句首:Luckily, the driver found it.;lucky 去掉 y 加 -ily。
We spent one more night in LA. 我们在洛杉矶多待了一晚;过去式 spent。
sit next to… 坐在……旁边;过去式 sat。i 是短音 /ɪ/,别读成 seat(座位)/siːt/。
比 woman 更礼貌:a nice lady 一位和善的女士;复数 ladies。
I can't believe it! 真不敢相信!;重音在后 be-LIEVE,结尾 v 要带声。
That's a great story! 真是个精彩的故事!;讲自己的经历也叫 story。

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Welcome home, you guys! So, what happened?
lines.zh: (周五中午,艾米到西雅图机场接他们)欢迎回家,你们俩!说说,到底发生了什么?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: First, I lost my phone in a car.
lines.zh: 先是我把手机丢在了一辆车上。

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: Luckily, the driver found it. He called me the next morning.
lines.zh: 幸好司机发现了。第二天早上他给我打了电话。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: He came to us with my phone, and I gave him a tip.
lines.zh: 他把手机给我们送了过来,我给了他小费。

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: After that, there was a big storm in Seattle.
lines.zh: 后来,西雅图来了一场大暴风雪。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: So we spent one more night in LA, at Ethan's house.
lines.zh: 所以我们在洛杉矶多待了一晚,住在伊森家。

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: No way! And what happened today?
lines.zh: 不会吧!那今天又发生了什么?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Today I sat next to a nice lady. I helped her with her bag.
lines.zh: 今天在飞机上,我坐在一位很和善的女士旁边,还帮她拿了行李。

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Wow, Lei! I can't believe it!

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: And finally, here we are! That's our story.
lines.zh: 最后,我们就回来啦!这就是我们的经历。

questions.prompt: 司机是怎么把手机还给磊的?
options: 第二天早上打电话给索菲亚,然后把手机送了过来
questions.explainZh: 索菲亚说 He called me the next morning.,磊说 He came to us with my phone.。

questions.prompt: 他们为什么在洛杉矶多待了一晚?
options: 西雅图有一场大暴风雪
questions.explainZh: After that, there was a big storm in Seattle. So we spent one more night in LA.。

questions.prompt: 今天在飞机上磊做了什么?
questions.explainZh: 磊说 Today I sat next to a nice lady. I helped her with her bag.。

grammar.bodyZh: 讲已经发生的事要用过去式。这几个常用动词的过去式不加 -ed,要单独记:lose → lost(丢)、find → found(找到)、give → gave(给)、spend → spent(度过;花)、sit → sat(坐);以前学过的还有 come → came、take → took、have → had、see → saw、make → made。规则动词照样加 -ed:help → helped、call → called、drop → dropped(双写 p)。否定句和问句里动词变回原形:I didn't find it. / Did you find it?(不说 Did you found it?)。发音:found 的 ou 读 /aʊ/,lost 的 o 美式读 /ɑː/,spent 结尾的 nt 要收住。

examples.text: I lost my phone, but the driver found it.
examples.zh: 我把手机丢了,不过司机找到了。

examples.text: We spent one more night in LA.
examples.zh: 我们在洛杉矶多待了一晚。

examples.text: Did you find it? — Yes, I did.

grammar.titleZh: What happened? 和讲经过的顺序词
grammar.bodyZh: 问“发生了什么事”用 What happened?——这里 what 自己就是主语,不用 did,不说 What did happen?。讲经过时按顺序用这些词把句子串起来:First,(首先)→ Then, / After that,(然后、后来)→ Finally,(最后)。Luckily,(幸好)放在句首,说事情往好的方向发展了。听别人讲时可以回应:No way!(不会吧!)、I can't believe it!(真不敢相信!)、That's a great story!。

examples.text: What happened? — First, I lost my phone.
examples.zh: 发生什么事了?——先是我把手机丢了。

examples.text: After that, there was a big storm.
examples.zh: 后来,来了一场大暴风雪。
